translations.web: You answered them, Yahweh our God. You are a God who forgave them, although you took vengeance for their doings.
translations.bsb: O LORD our God, You answered them. You were a forgiving God to them, yet an avenger of their misdeeds.
translations.kjv: Thou answeredst them, O LORD our God: thou wast a God that forgavest them, though thou tookest vengeance of their inventions.
translations.asv: Thou answeredst them, O Jehovah our God: Thou wast a God that forgavest them, Though thou tookest vengeance of their doings.
